name: TetSplat Pre-processing and Data Layout
definition: Pre-processing step that quantizes scalar field values to [0, 1] and packs them into a binary bitstring for efficient storage and transmission.
summary: TetSplat Pre-processing and Data Layout quantizes scalar fields and serializes hierarchical Shell and Solid structures into a single binary stream with embedded traversal pointers for efficient, interactive visualization of large tetrahedral meshes.
